chunks.sanskrit: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
chunks.l1:
## pan-p01 (1)
what-was-done-by-me-in-truth / indeed / by-me / done / my / O-Lord / duty / indeed / not / beyond-this / higher / which / my-pride / on-the-Lord's-lotus-feet / with-devotion / by-me / indeed / offered / my-all / therefore / indeed / this / other / not / exists / indeed / I-know / therefore / having-abandoned / quickly / O-protector-of-the-helpless / O-ocean-of-compassion / pleased / be
chunks.l2: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride has been offered by me with devotion on the Lord's lotus feet. This is my all; I know there is nothing other than this. Therefore, having cast all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased!
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p01 — argument map

What is true of my doing = one duty = offering of pride. My all = this offering; anything other does not exist, for me. Renunciation already accomplished (tyaktvā) grounds the plea: be pleased.

### Open
- Whether prasāda means 'pleasure' or 'grace' is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: maheśa tvaddvāri sphuratu rucirā vāgatitarāṃ mamaiṣā nirdoṣaṃ jaya jaya maheśeti satatam | śivā saiṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyamaniśaṃ maheśanāthaṃ māṃ śaraṇada sanāthaṃ kuru vibho
chunks.l1:
## pan-p02 (2)
O-Maheśa / at-Your-door / let-flash-forth / charming / speech / exceedingly / my / this / faultless / victory / victory / O-Maheśa / thus / constantly / auspicious / that / this / speech / let-it-be / bliss-bestowing / for-me / unceasingly / having-Maheśa-as-protector / me / O-giver-of-refuge / possessed-of-a-protector / make / O-Lord
chunks.l2: O Maheśa, at Your door let this charming speech of mine flash forth exceedingly — "Victory, victory to Maheśa!" — faultless and unceasing. Let this very speech, auspicious, be bliss-giving for me forever. O Lord, O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — possessed of a protector!
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p02 — argument map

Praise at the door is the offering. The cry 'jaya jaya maheśa' is both act and instrument. Status (sanātha) turns into request (make possessed of a protector).

### Open
- Whether śivadā means 'bliss-bestowing' or 'Śiva-giving' is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: brūṣe nottamāṅga paśyasi na māmetādṛśaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vijñaptiṃ bahudhā kṛtāṃ na śṛṇuṣe nāyāsi manmānase | saṃsārārṇavagartamadhyapatitaṃ prāyeṇa nālambase vākcakṣuḥśravaṇāṅghriṇādirahitaṃ tvāmāha satyaṃ śrutiḥ
chunks.l1:
## pan-p03 (3)
You-speak / not / O-best-limbed-one / You-see / not / me / such / suffering / entreaty / in-many-ways / made / not / You-listen / not / You-come / into-my-mind / fallen-into-the-pit-amid-the-ocean-of-transmigration / mostly / not / You-support / devoid-of-speech-sight-hearing-feet-and-the-like / You / declares / truly / scripture
chunks.l2: You speak not, O best-limbed one; You look not upon me, wretched as I am. My entreaty, made in many ways, You hear not; You come not into my mind. Fallen amid the pit of the ocean of transmigration, I am mostly left unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You devoid of speech, sight, hearing, feet and the like!
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p03 — argument map

Five refusals charged: speak, see, hear, come, support. Scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free. prāyeṇa softens the unsupported claim.

### Open
- Whether the turn to śruti is sincere resolution or ironic resignation is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: gurorvākyādyukti-pracaya-racana-unmārjana-vaśātsamāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samucitādapi kathitam | vilīne śaṅkābhre hṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśatu caraṇān dhvāntajayinaḥ
chunks.l1:
## pan-p04 (4)
of-the-guru / from-the-word / by-force-of-wiping-away-the-fabric-of-piled-up-reasonings / from-assurance / scripture / regarding / from-what-is-fitting / even / told / when-dissolved / the-cloud-of-doubt / whose-splendor-shines-in-the-heart-sky / of-the-Lord / of-the-sun / like / let-touch / the-feet / of-the-darkness-conquering-one
chunks.l2: From the guru's word — by the force that wipes away the fabric of heaped-up reasonings — and from the assurance told, fittingly, out of regard for scripture: when the cloud of doubt has dissolved, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor shines in the sky of the heart — like the sun, the conqueror of darkness.
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p04 — argument map

Two testimonies: guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance. Their force wipes away (not refutes) heaped reasonings. Doubt-cloud dissolved, touch the feet of the heart-sky Lord.

### Open
- Whether guru's word and scripture are two distinct sources or one twofold source is unresolved.

chunks.sanskrit: yātastvatsahavāsato bahutaraḥ kālo vatāsmin kṣaṇe kiṃ kiṃ vā na kṛtaṃ tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me | vāraṃ vāramahaṃ punarnirupamāṃ divyaṃ bhuvaṃ prāsuvatkāyastvāṃ kila vismarāmi yadataḥ stheyaṃ na bhūyastvayā
chunks.l1:
## pan-p05 (5)
gone / from-dwelling-with-You / very-long / time / alas / in-this / moment / what / what / or / not / done / by-You / for-the-sake-of-serving-the-excellent-guru / for-me / time / after-time / I / again / incomparable / divine / plane / whose-body-has-attained-it / You / indeed / I-forget / since / therefore / to-be-remained / not / further / by-You
chunks.l2: Much time dwelling with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What, what has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru! Again and again I, whose body has attained the incomparable divine plane — yet indeed I forget You. Therefore, by You let there be no further staying-away! *Fidelity: preserved (all 5 verses, full pāda coverage from T1). Added: connective phrasing only. Not resolved: the formation prāsuvatkāyaḥ (v. 5c) is obscure; glossed as "whose body has attained it" and marked uncertain in the argmap.*
chunks.argmap:
## pan-p05 — argument map

Long dwelling-with and total grace received. Repeated forgetting admitted (kila). Therefore no further staying-away requested.

### Open
- prāsuvatkāyaḥ is obscure; glossed 'whose body has attained it'.
